name: Step Behind Rotational Med Ball Throw
how_to:
1. Start Side-On to a solid wall or open space, holding a light medicine ball (2–6 kg).
2. Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and the ball held at waist height.
3. Step your rear foot behind and across your front foot (like a crossover step).
4. As your rear foot lands, rotate your hips toward the wall and transfer your weight forward.
5. Explosively rotate your torso and shoulders, releasing the ball in a side-throw motion.
6. Allow full hip and shoulder rotation, finishing tall and balanced.
7. Reset between reps and repeat on the opposite side.
